title: Scent Taipei 2027 puts Taiwan's growing fragrance market in the spotlight
summary: Returning from March 26 to 29, 2027, alongside Beautyworld Taipei, Scent Taipei will expand its showcase of international and local fragrance brands, offering a platform to explore opportunities in Taiwan's fast-evolving scent market. As fragrance gains traction among Taiwanese consumers, Scent Taipei is preparing an expanded edition to connect international brands with local distributors, retailers and consumers.
